messages:
alex: Quick smoke before canary — is streaming convo still sending func_call deltas + a final assistant message? trying to avoid double-exec on client.

maria: we changed the behavior last week. deltas can include func_call chunks, but only the final event is guaranteed to be the full message. why double-exec concern?

alex: some clients trigger on seeing a func_call.name in a delta and run the tool immediately; others wait for an explicit 'complete' signal. that mismatch can cause duplicate side effects.

jordan: agreed. current contract (what runtime emits): treat func_call in streaming deltas as in-progress. only invoke external tool after the final message or when delta.func_call.complete === true. we added a "complete" boolean as canonical signal.

sam: where is that surface-level text? I see the PR but SDK disagrees with parsing behavior.

maria: docs PR is in review: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/320 — TL;DR: stream events may look like: ```json
{"event":"delta","delta":{"role":null,"content":null,"func_call":{"name":"search","args":"{\"q\":\"foo\"}"}}}
``` then final: ```json
{"event":"final","message":{"role":"assistant","content":"results...","func_call":{"name":"search","args":{"q":"foo"}}}}
```

deploy-bot: convo-schema-lint failed on branch convo-stream-fix — error: "func_call.args may be string or object" :warning:

maria: ah — runtime still emits args as a JSON string for streaming to avoid partial-JSON headaches. SDK lint expects object. jordan, can we pick one or do compat?

jordan: recommendation: keep streaming.func_call.args as string (backward compatible and simpler for incremental deltas). final.message.func_call.args should be normalized to object when possible. runtime will emit string in deltas; final will attempt to parse into object and emit object if parse succeeds, otherwise leave string. we'll add telemetry for parse failures.

sam: ok I'll make SDK accept both string and object for args and add a warning log when we coerce.

leo: I'll add a small smoke test in runtime-tests to assert that: 1) delta.func_call.args is a string, 2) final.func_call.args may be object, 3) clients should not act on deltas without complete flag. ping me sample payloads.

alex: example payload I'm testing locally: ```json
{"event":"delta","delta":{"func_call":{"name":"search","args":"{\"q\":\"foo\"}"}}}
``` then final: ```json
{"event":"final","message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Found 10 results","func_call":{"name":"search","args":{"q":"foo"}}}}
```

maria: action items: 1) sam update SDK to accept both (ETA EOD), 2) leo add smoke tests & link PR, 3) jordan add telemetry + docs note, 4) i will land docs PR after small edits.

jordan: I'll add the telemetry metric: convo.stream.func_call.args_parse_fail=true for any stream->final parse issue.

alex: I'll hold canary until CI is green and smoke tests pass. thanks everyone. :thumbsup: :eyes:
